_: The looks every Phi app offers, first the default. A look is a puikit theme style, the brand that voices it, the seeded palette that colours it ('none' = the brand's), its gradient level and corner preset; `mode` the light or dark it opens in, `ground` the window's ground it lays (tokens/_ground.scss), '' or none for the page's own. Read by looks.ts. `swatch`: the colours its picture in Settings is drawn in, its ground's first at the left.

looks.label: SpaceX
looks.note: the rocket-interior look, the house default: instrument-blue seams, brushed panels, square edges

looks.label: Apple
looks.note: rounder than the others (the 48px corner), its sidebars a hairline of light; it opens dark on Apple's night ground, and the light is a switch

looks.label: Glass
looks.note: every surface is glass over the theme's own colours, blurred

looks.label: Gradient
looks.note: every surface and label wears the brand's two colours (_theme-styles.scss); Phiogy's own look

looks.label: Jingle
looks.note: one gradient under the whole window, the brand's own, and the kit's plain light on everything over it
